title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 4,151–4,200 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 高山登山運動；百岳攀登

examples.en: High-altitude mountaineering demands physical endurance, navigation skills, and mental grit.
examples.zh: 攀登三千公尺以上的高山百岳極度考驗充沛的心肺體能、精準的離線地圖導航與強大心理素質。

examples.en: She took a comprehensive mountaineering safety course before planning her first expedition.
examples.zh: 在規劃自己的首場百岳遠征縱走之前，她報名參加了完整的高山登山安全訓練課程。

examples.en: Taiwan's rugged central ridge offers world-class mountaineering terrain for adventurous hikers.
examples.zh: 台灣險峻高聳的中央山脈主脊樑，為熱愛冒險的山友提供了世界級的壯麗高山攀登地形。

words.definition: 百岳山峰；頂峰；高峰期

examples.en: Mt. Jade Main Peak reaches 3,952 meters, the highest mountain in Northeast Asia.
examples.zh: 壯麗雄偉的玉山主峰海拔高達三千九百五十二公尺，傲視群倫榮登東北亞第一高峰。

examples.en: Electricity demand reaches its peak during sweltering summer weekday afternoons.
examples.zh: 全台用電需求在酷熱難耐的夏季平日午後往往會飆升至全天最高峰期。

examples.en: The mountaineers celebrated joyfully after reaching the snowy summit peak at dawn.
examples.zh: 歷經艱辛跋涉的登山隊員們在黎明破曉時分登頂白雪皚皚的山峰頂點，激動相擁歡呼慶祝。

words.definition: 冰斗；冰河圈谷 (Glacial Cirque)

examples.en: Xueshan Cirque No. 1 is Taiwan's largest glacial cirque, filled with alpine junipers.
examples.zh: 雪山一號圈谷是全台灣面積最為遼闊的壯麗冰河圈谷遺跡，谷底遍布蒼勁的台灣冷杉與玉山圓柏。

examples.en: Geologists hike to the ancient cirque to study rock formations left by prehistoric glaciers.
examples.zh: 地質學家不辭辛勞徒步跋涉至古老的冰河圈谷，實地考察史前冰川退縮所遺留的擦痕岩層。

examples.en: In early winter, the towering amphitheater walls of the cirque become blanketed in pure white snow.
examples.zh: 初冬時節，冰斗圈谷那宛如古羅馬競技場般高聳環抱的岩壁，會被一整片純白厚雪全面覆蓋。

words.definition: 山脊；稜線；山脈稜線步道

examples.en: Hikers tread cautiously along the knife-edge rocky ridge under gusty alpine winds.
examples.zh: 登山客頂著山頂呼嘯的強勁強陣風，小心翼翼行走在兩側皆為萬丈深淵的刀鋒岩稜稜線上。

examples.en: The panoramic mountain trail winds gently along the high grassy ridge for several miles.
examples.zh: 這條視野壯闊的高山步道沿著綠意盎然的高山箭竹草坡稜線平緩蜿蜒數公里之遙。

examples.en: A dense blanket of fog rolled over the rocky ridge, obscuring the path ahead within seconds.
examples.zh: 一陣濃稠的大霧瞬間翻過崎嶇岩石山脊，在短短數秒內便完全吞沒了前方的行進山徑。

words.definition: 入園許可證；入山證；許可執照

examples.en: Apply for national park entry permits and mountain cabin beds months in advance.
examples.zh: 攀登熱門百岳路線請務必提前數月上網向國家公園管理處申請入園許可證並抽籤登記山屋床位。

examples.en: Park rangers at the trailhead carefully inspect each climber's identification and hiking permit.
examples.zh: 國家公園巡山員在登山口仔細核對每一位入山山友的身分證件與合規入園許可證。

examples.en: You need to obtain a special municipal permit before constructing an extension onto your home.
examples.zh: 在自宅空地動工加蓋任何延伸建築結構之前，依法必須先向當地建管處申請特別建築施工許可證。

words.definition: 海拔高度；垂直爬升高度

examples.en: The steep day hike features an elevation gain of 1,200 vertical meters.
examples.zh: 這條極具挑戰性的單攻健行路線單日累積垂直爬升高度超過一千二百公尺。

examples.en: Air pressure and oxygen levels decrease noticeably at an elevation above 3,000 meters.
examples.zh: 當海拔高度攀升至三千公尺以上時，大氣壓力與空氣中的氧氣分壓會出現非常顯著的下降。

examples.en: The architectural blueprints show the south exterior elevation of the modern residential tower.
examples.zh: 建築設計施工藍圖詳盡繪製了這棟現代住宅大樓朝南向的外部立面外觀圖（Elevation）。

words.definition: 地形等高線；輪廓外型

examples.en: Dense contour lines on the topographic map indicate an extremely steep precipice.
examples.zh: 登山專用地形圖上密密麻麻密集重疊的等高線，代表前方即將迎來近乎垂直的險峻峭壁。

examples.en: The ergonomic chair is sculpted to follow the natural contours of the human spine.
examples.zh: 這張人體工學辦公椅經過立體精密曲面雕琢，能完全貼合人體脊椎自然的生理曲線輪廓。

examples.en: Paying close attention to contour intervals helps navigators calculate safe ascent routes.
examples.zh: 仔細辨識地形圖上的等高線間距與高程，能幫助領隊嚮導規劃出體力負荷最適切的安全爬升路線。

words.definition: 衛星定位導航；航海

examples.en: Download offline GPX track maps onto your phone for reliable backcountry navigation.
examples.zh: 出發前請務必將離線 GPX 軌跡航跡地圖完整下載存入手機 App 中，以確保在無收訊深山中精準導航。

examples.en: Even with advanced satellite navigation, always carry a traditional magnetic compass and paper map.
examples.zh: 即便隨身攜帶了高科技衛星定位手機 App，背包裡也務必備妥傳統指北針與紙本地形圖以防萬一。

examples.en: Poor visibility in dense alpine fog makes precise GPS navigation essential for survival.
examples.zh: 當高山突降白牆濃霧導致能見度降至極低時，精準無誤的 GPS 軌跡導航是平安保命的絕對關鍵。

words.definition: 高海拔高度適應；水土適應

examples.en: Spending a night at intermediate altitude aids physical acclimatization to thin air.
examples.zh: 在登頂前一晚先於中海拔山莊住宿一晚進行充分的高山高度適應，能大幅降低急性高山症機率。

examples.en: Proper physiological acclimatization allows your bone marrow to produce more red blood cells.
examples.zh: 良好的高海拔高度生理適應，能刺激人體骨髓製造更多紅血球以攜帶更多寶貴氧氣。

examples.en: Rushing upward without gradual acclimatization dramatically increases the risk of severe altitude sickness.
examples.zh: 若未經循序漸進的高度適應就盲目快速拔高海拔，會使罹患嚴重急性高山症的風險呈指數級飆升。

words.definition: 丹木斯（預防急性高山症藥物）

examples.en: Taking preventive Diamox tablets twice daily helps prevent acute mountain sickness (AMS).
examples.zh: 依家醫科或旅遊門診醫師處方，登山前一天起早晚各服用半顆丹木斯（Diamox）能有效預防高山症。

examples.en: Common side effects of Diamox include harmless tingling sensations in your fingers and toes.
examples.zh: 服用丹木斯最常見的輕微副作用，是手指尖與腳趾末梢會產生無害但微麻的刺痛感。

examples.en: Consult a physician at a travel medicine clinic before taking Diamox for your high-altitude trek.
examples.zh: 在出發展開高海拔遠征徒步之前，請務必先前往旅遊醫學門診諮詢專業醫師開立丹木斯處方。

words.definition: 登山包內骨架；框架結構

examples.en: Ergonomic internal frame backpacks transfer heavy expedition loads comfortably to hips.
examples.zh: 人體工學高剛性鋁合金內骨架重裝登山包能將重達數十公斤的縱走裝備重量均勻分散至腰臀骨盆。

examples.en: The durable aluminum frame of the tent withstands ferocious alpine gusts without bending.
examples.zh: 帳篷所採用的航太級高強度鋁合金骨架結構，能硬抗高山呼嘯狂風吹襲而始終不彎曲變形。

examples.en: She picked out a pair of stylish tortoiseshell frames for her new prescription reading glasses.
examples.zh: 她為自己新配的近視老花眼鏡挑選了一副極具文藝氣息與質感的復古玳瑁鏡框。

words.definition: 遠足健行；徒步縱走 (Trek)

examples.en: Dual lightweight carbon-fiber trekking poles reduce knee stress during long rocky descents.
examples.zh: 雙手握持超輕量碳纖維登山杖能有效在陡峭下坡路段分擔雙膝衝擊力並維持平衡。

examples.en: Nepal attracts adventurers from around the world for multi-week high-altitude trekking holidays.
examples.zh: 尼泊爾喜馬拉雅山脈每年吸引全球數以萬計的探險愛好者，前來進行為期數週的高海拔徒步縱走。

examples.en: Sturdy waterproof boots with vibram rubber soles provide excellent traction for alpine trekking.
examples.zh: 一雙配備黃金大底耐磨抓地橡膠鞋底的重裝防水登山靴，能為崎嶇高山健行提供無比強大的防滑抓地力。

words.definition: 登山防護綁腿；鞋套

examples.en: Waterproof ankle gaiters keep mud, scree, and leeches from creeping into boots.
examples.zh: 穿戴防撕裂防水透氣登山綁腿能防止泥濘爛泥、碎石落石與恐怖的螞蝗水蛭鑽入登山鞋內。

examples.en: Fastening your heavy-duty winter gaiters over snow pants seals out icy powder on glaciers.
examples.zh: 將厚實保暖的冬季雪地登山綁腿嚴密束緊在雪褲外層，能徹底阻絕鬆軟冰雪倒灌進鞋筒內。

examples.en: The elastic underfoot strap of the gaiter broke after miles of walking through sharp volcanic rocks.
examples.zh: 在長時間行走穿梭於鋒利的火山玄武岩碎石路段後，登山綁腿底部的橡膠耐磨固定帶不幸磨損斷裂。

words.definition: 排汗快乾的；毛細吸濕作用

examples.en: Synthetic moisture-wicking base layers pull sweat away from the body rapidly.
examples.zh: 高機能吸濕快乾排汗底衫能第一時間將劇烈爬坡時排出的汗水導離皮膚表層，保持乾爽。

examples.en: High-performance wicking socks keep feet dry, preventing painful blister formation on long hikes.
examples.zh: 高性能吸濕快乾羊毛登山襪能常保雙腳全天乾爽舒適，防止長途跋涉時因潮濕摩擦起水泡。

examples.en: Avoid wearing pure cotton because it absorbs water heavily without providing any moisture-wicking ability.
examples.zh: 登山時切忌穿著純棉內衣褲，因為純棉吸水後奇重無比且完全不具備任何毛細排汗快乾功效。

words.definition: 刷毛抓絨中層衣；羊毛絨

examples.en: A breathable polyester fleece jacket traps body heat effectively during brisk summit rests.
examples.zh: 在寒風凜冽的山頂三角點休息喘息時，套上一件透氣保暖的刷毛抓絨外套能迅速鎖住核心體溫。

examples.en: Lightweight micro-fleece pullovers dry quickly even after being washed in cold mountain streams.
examples.zh: 輕量透氣的超細抓絨套頭中層衫即使在冰冷溪水中清洗過後，掛在通風處也能迅速風乾。

examples.en: The fluffy fleece lining of the winter sleeping bag felt warm and luxurious against cold skin.
examples.zh: 冬用睡袋內層加厚柔軟的刷毛保暖內膽，在接觸到冰冷肌膚時帶來如雲朵般的奢華溫暖。

words.definition: 鵝絨羽絨；羽毛；向下

examples.en: 850 fill-power goose down offers the ultimate warmth-to-weight ratio for sub-zero bivvies.
examples.zh: 填充 850FP 高蓬鬆度頂級白鵝絨的輕量羽絨外套，在零度以下雪地高山營地提供極致防寒保暖。

examples.en: Compressible down sleeping bags pack down into tiny bundles inside your backpack.
examples.zh: 壓縮比極高的高蓬鬆羽絨睡袋能被緊密擠壓塞入壓縮袋中，在背包內僅佔據極小微量空間。

examples.en: Keep your down jacket protected from rain because wet down clumps and loses all insulating loft.
examples.zh: 務必妥善保護羽絨外套免受雨水浸濕，因為羽絨一旦遇水結塊便會瞬間喪失所有蓬鬆保暖絕緣能力。

words.definition: 硬殼防水衝鋒衣；硬殼的

examples.en: A robust Gore-Tex hardshell jacket shields climbers against torrential downpours and howling blizzards.
examples.zh: 具備三層防撕裂結構的頂級 Gore-Tex 硬殼防水衝鋒外套能抵禦滂沱暴雨與呼嘯高山暴風雪。

examples.en: Make sure your waterproof hardshell features underarm pit zips for active ventilation while ascending.
examples.zh: 挑選硬殼風雨衣時務必確認腋下配備防水透氣拉鍊，以便在高強度爬坡時隨時拉開排熱通風。

examples.en: Pack a lightweight three-layer hardshell even if the morning mountain weather forecast appears sunny.
examples.zh: 即便清晨出發時山下氣象預報陽光明媚，登山背包中也永遠必須常備一件專業三層硬殼衝鋒衣。

words.definition: 低體溫症；致命失溫危險

examples.en: Wet cotton clothing in cold winds accelerates life-threatening hypothermia within minutes.
examples.zh: 在高山強風中穿著吸水潮濕的純棉衣服會迅速抽乾人體熱量，短短數分鐘內即可能引發致命失溫。

examples.en: Early symptoms of hypothermia include uncontrollable shivering, slurred speech, and clumsiness.
examples.zh: 急性失溫低體溫症的初期典型症狀包括止不住的劇烈發抖打顫、言語不清含糊以及手腳動作失調。

examples.en: Immediately wrap the shivering climber in a dry sleeping bag and warm thermal layers to reverse hypothermia.
examples.zh: 請立即將瑟瑟發抖的失溫山友用乾燥睡袋與多層保暖衣物層層包覆，以迅速遏止並逆轉失溫惡化。

words.definition: 登山必備高亮度頭燈

examples.en: Inspect your 400-lumen headlamp and carry extra lithium batteries before early dawn departures.
examples.zh: 在凌晨兩點摸黑起登出發前，請務必再三檢查四百流明高亮度登山頭燈電量並備妥備用電池。

examples.en: Using a headlamp keeps your hands completely free to hold trekking poles and scramble up rocky ledges.
examples.zh: 佩戴頭燈能徹底解放雙手，讓登山者能從容握持登山杖並手腳並用抓握岩壁攀爬直上。

examples.en: Switching your headlamp to red-light mode preserves night vision inside crowded mountain huts.
examples.zh: 在深夜或凌晨進出擁擠的山屋時將頭燈切換至紅光低光模式，能保護夜視力且絕不打擾山友睡眠。

words.definition: 高山避難山莊；山屋；寄宿

examples.en: Yushan Paiyun Lodge provides hot dinners and bunk beds for summit bound hikers.
examples.zh: 玉山排雲山莊為準備隔日清晨攻頂玉山主峰的國內外登山好手提供熱騰騰便當與上下舖床位。

examples.en: Hikers rested by the roaring hearth of the mountain lodge after a grueling rainy traverse.
examples.zh: 在歷經一整天淒風苦雨的艱辛縱走跋涉後，疲憊的山友們圍坐在高山避難山屋溫暖的火爐旁烤火歇息。

examples.en: She decided to lodge a formal complaint with the consumer bureau regarding unfair cancellation fees.
examples.zh: 面對旅行社無理扣留全額退款的霸王條款，她決定正式向行政院消保處提出正式申訴與檢舉。

words.definition: 搭設帳棚；投球；音高

examples.en: Pitch your ultralight tent on flat ground and secure all guylines with stakes.
examples.zh: 在平整的高山營地上俐落搭設超輕量雙人自立帳，並將所有抗風營繩以營釘牢牢拉緊打入土中。

examples.en: It took only four minutes for the experienced campers to pitch their tarp in the storm.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的野營老手在狂風暴雨中僅耗時短短四分鐘，便極速搭設好了一頂抗風天幕避難所。

examples.en: The singer possessed perfect pitch and could identify any musical note instantly without looking.
examples.zh: 這位女歌手天生擁有罕見的絕對音高天賦，在完全不看樂譜的情況下能瞬間聽音辨識出任何音符。

words.definition: 自立式帳篷的；獨立無支撐的

examples.en: Freestanding dome tents remain stable even on hard rocky alpine campgrounds.
examples.zh: 採用交叉營柱結構的自立式雙人穹頂帳篷，即使在無法打營釘的堅硬高山碎石營地也能穩固挺立。

examples.en: A freestanding shelter does not require stakes or trekking poles to stand erect in the wind.
examples.zh: 自立式帳篷無需依賴營釘拉繩或登山杖支撐，即可自身在強風中獨立立體撐起完整結構。

examples.en: The living room features a striking freestanding marble fireplace that serves as an architectural partition.
examples.zh: 豪宅客廳中央坐落著一座造型前衛大膽的獨立自立式大理石壁爐，巧妙兼具了空間隔斷的美學機能。

words.definition: 隔熱防寒絕緣層；隔音

examples.en: An inflatable sleeping pad with an R-value of 4.5 blocks freezing ground chill.
examples.zh: 挑選隔熱值（R-value）高達 4.5 以上的充氣防潮睡墊能徹底阻絕冰冷地表寒氣直透背脊。

examples.en: Installing double-glazed windows provides superior thermal insulation for mountain cabins.
examples.zh: 在高山避難山屋安裝雙層中空隔音隔熱玻璃氣密窗，能為室內提供卓越的鎖溫防寒隔熱效果。

examples.en: High-grade closed-cell foam provides reliable puncture-proof insulation for budget backpackers.
examples.zh: 高品質閉孔蛋巢型發泡防潮睡墊耐磨且絕無刺破漏氣風險，是小資背包客最可靠的防寒保暖底墊。

words.definition: 高山異丁烷瓦斯罐；小筒

examples.en: Isobutane fuel canisters vaporize efficiently in sub-zero alpine winter conditions.
examples.zh: 調配特定比例的高山專用異丁烷抗低溫高山瓦斯罐，在零下酷寒雪地環境中依然能強勁氣化燃燒。

examples.en: Weigh the fuel canister before each hiking trip to calculate remaining cooking burn time.
examples.zh: 每次出發爬山前先拿料理秤量取瓦斯罐淨重，能精準推算出剩餘燃料還可供煮水烹調多少分鐘。

examples.en: Keep your metal tea canister tightly sealed to protect dried leaves from pantry humidity.
examples.zh: 將裝有阿里山高山茶葉的金屬雙層馬口鐵茶葉罐蓋緊密封，以防止茶葉受潮吸附異味而變質。

words.definition: 低溫真空凍乾的；乾燥飯

examples.en: Lightweight freeze-dried meals reconstitute into delicious hot bibimbap with boiling water.
examples.zh: 輕量小巧的真空冷凍乾燥飯只需注入滾燙熱水悶煮十分鐘，瞬間還原成熱氣騰騰的美味拌飯。

examples.en: Freeze-dried berries retain ninety-seven percent of their original vitamins and antioxidant nutrients.
examples.zh: 經過先進超低溫真空冷凍乾燥技術處理的藍莓與草莓乾，完整保留了高達九成七的原生維生素。

examples.en: Carrying freeze-dried hiking rations dramatically shaves pack weight on remote multi-day routes.
examples.zh: 在挑戰無補給的高山長天數縱走路線時全程背負冷凍乾燥乾燥飯，能極致減輕登山背包總重量。

words.definition: 登山綜合果乾堅果行動糧

examples.en: Munching on trail mix with roasted almonds and dried cranberries maintains steady energy.
examples.zh: 在行進間隨手抓一把包含低溫烘焙杏仁果、核桃與蔓越莓乾的綜合行動糧能持續提供穩定熱量。

examples.en: Custom homemade trail mix with dark chocolate chips and walnuts satisfies sweet cravings.
examples.zh: 親手將高純度苦甜黑巧克力豆與生核桃混拌而成的自製能量行動糧，能及時滿足高山上的甜食渴望。

examples.en: Keep a ziplock bag of salty trail mix accessible in your hip belt pocket while moving.
examples.zh: 在登山背包腰帶的小拉鍊袋中常備一包加入少許海鹽的綜合果乾堅果，邊走邊吃隨時補充電解質。

words.definition: 野外微孔濾水過濾

examples.en: Hollow-fiber membrane water filtration removes 99.999% of bacteria and protozoa from mountain streams.
examples.zh: 採用中空絲膜微孔過濾技術的隨身野外濾水器，能徹底濾除溪水中百分之九十九以上的病菌與原蟲。

examples.en: Gravity water filtration systems allow mountaineering groups to filter four liters without manual pumping.
examples.zh: 採用重力自流式的吊掛式戶外大容量濾水系統，讓登山隊伍無需費力手動按壓即可快速淨化四公升水源。

examples.en: Inspect the filtration cartridge regularly to prevent sediment clogging after dipping in silted pools.
examples.zh: 定期逆向反洗檢查微孔濾芯濾膜，能有效防止在泥沙淤積的微濁看天池取水時發生濾芯堵塞。

words.definition: 飲用水殺菌淨化；淨化

examples.en: Chlorine dioxide water purification tablets neutralize waterborne viruses in murky puddles.
examples.zh: 二氧化氯水質淨化消毒錠能在三十分鐘內徹底滅活看天池微濁積水中的各類水生有害病毒。

examples.en: Boiling untreated surface water vigorously for three minutes provides complete viral purification.
examples.zh: 將戶外野外採集到的未經處理生水持續劇烈沸騰滾煮三分鐘以上，能達成完全殺菌的水質淨化。

examples.en: Practicing mindfulness meditation is a psychological purification ritual that eases modern mental clutter.
examples.zh: 每天規律進行正念呼吸冥想，是一場洗滌心靈塵埃、淨化現代人繁雜思緒的精神沉澱儀式。

words.definition: 無痕山林準則 (LNT)；道德原則

examples.en: Practicing the seven Leave No Trace (LNT) principles preserves wild trails pristine.
examples.zh: 身體力行恪守「無痕山林」（Leave No Trace）七大準則，是每一位山友守護原始山林的最高信仰。

examples.en: Standing firm on personal moral principles is vital when navigating workplace dilemmas.
examples.zh: 當在職場中面臨利益誘惑與複雜倫理兩難時，堅守個人的道德原則底線顯得尤為重要。

examples.en: The core principles of backcountry ethics require hikers to respect wildlife and camp on durable surfaces.
examples.zh: 無痕山林的核心準則明確要求登山者務必尊重野生動物習性，並始終在堅硬耐久地表上紮營。

words.definition: 密封袋；小袋子；育兒袋

examples.en: Pack all food wrappers, fruit peels, and toilet paper into sealed trash pouches.
examples.zh: 將所有泡麵包裝袋、果皮廚餘與使用過的衛生紙全數裝入防臭密封垃圾袋，親自背負下山。

examples.en: A mother kangaroo keeps her newborn joey safe and warm inside her marsupial pouch.
examples.zh: 袋鼠媽媽將剛剛誕生不久的脆弱袋鼠寶寶，妥善保護在溫暖安全的腹部育兒袋中。

examples.en: Keep your passport and cash tucked securely inside a water-resistant neck security pouch.
examples.zh: 在出國自助旅行時，將護照證件與備用現金妥善收納在貼身防潑水防搶掛頸證件暗袋中。

words.definition: 野外求生；生存生還

examples.en: Carrying a basic wilderness survival kit provides reassurance in emergencies.
examples.zh: 登山大背包內始終常備一套包含求生毯、打火石與急救包的野外求生組，在關鍵時刻能拯救生命。

examples.en: Learning how to build an emergency shelter and start fire is vital for mountain survival.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握如何就地取材搭建緊急避難所與鑽木生火，是身陷荒野時保命求生的必備核心技能。

examples.en: The lone castaway's incredible story of oceanic survival captivated readers across the globe.
examples.zh: 這位海上遇難船員在浩瀚大洋上孤身漂流生還的奇蹟求生歷程，深深震撼了全球無數讀者。

words.definition: 哨子短促響亮的長鳴吹奏；爆炸

examples.en: Blow three loud blasts on your emergency whistle to signal international distress.
examples.zh: 用力吹響隨身攜帶的高音救生哨發出「短吹三聲」長鳴，是全體搜救人員皆懂的國際求救信號。

examples.en: A sudden freezing blast of Arctic wind shook the alpine tents violently throughout the night.
examples.zh: 一陣突如其來的極地刺骨狂風呼嘯而過，整夜劇烈搖撼著高山露營營地上搭設的帳篷。

examples.en: Controlled dynamite blasts helped engineers carve the highway tunnel through solid granite mountains.
examples.zh: 精準定向的炸藥控制爆破工程，協助工程團隊在堅不可摧的堅硬花崗岩山體深處開鑿出公路隧道。

words.definition: 輕量緊急防風避難袋 (Bivvy Bag)

examples.en: An emergency reflective bivvy sack prevents rapid heat loss during unexpected bivouacs.
examples.zh: 一只僅重百餘克的鋁箔反射式輕量緊急求生避難袋，在深山被迫迫降過夜時能有效防止致命失溫。

examples.en: Waterproof breathable bivvy bags allow solo alpine climbers to sleep safely on tiny cliff ledges.
examples.zh: 具備防水透氣性能的單人露宿袋，讓獨攀阿爾卑斯式攀登者得以在狹窄險峻的岩壁縫隙安全露宿。

examples.en: Always tuck an ultralight bivvy bag into your daypack before venturing onto technical trails.
examples.zh: 在踏上具有地形技術難度的百岳攀爬路線前，務必將一只超輕量緊急避難袋塞進攻頂小包備用。

words.definition: 鎂棒打火棒 (Fire Starter)；發動機

examples.en: Ferrocerium fire starters shower 3,000°C sparks to ignite tinder even in rain.
examples.zh: 鎂塊打火棒（Fire Starter）能在刮刀刮擦下瞬間噴射出三千度高溫火星，雨天也能點燃引火柴。

examples.en: Strike the fire starter firmly against dry cotton balls infused with petroleum jelly for instant fire.
examples.zh: 拿刮刀用力朝向事先浸泡過凡士林的乾燥棉花球快速刮動打火棒，數秒內即可成功引燃烈火。

examples.en: The car wouldn't turn on because the electrical engine starter motor had worn out.
examples.zh: 汽車停在路邊突然無法發動點火，經過原廠技師檢測發現是底盤發電機啟動馬達老化損壞。

words.definition: 多功能折疊工具鉗（含小刀）

examples.en: A compact stainless steel multi-tool features pliers, scissors, and a razor-sharp blade.
examples.zh: 一把精密的折疊式不鏽鋼多功能工具鉗整合了強大鉗口、小剪刀與銳利小刀，能應對各種維修。

examples.en: He used the wire cutters on his pocket multi-tool to repair broken camping stove brackets.
examples.zh: 他抽出隨身多功能工具鉗上的斜口剪線鉗配件，俐落修復了高山爐具被石塊砸凹變形的支架。

examples.en: A quality multi-tool is the most versatile EDC pocket companion for wilderness adventurers.
examples.zh: 一把作工精良的多功能工具鉗是荒野探險家日常隨身攜帶（EDC）最具實用多工價值的身邊好物。

words.definition: 腳底摩擦水泡；起水泡

examples.en: Apply hydrocolloid blister pads at the first friction hot spot to prevent tears.
examples.zh: 一旦察覺腳跟或腳趾出現發熱摩擦微痛點，立即貼上人工皮水泡貼片以防表皮摩擦磨破起水泡。

examples.en: Breaking in new hiking boots on local hills prevents painful heel blisters on the big trip.
examples.zh: 剛買的新登山靴務必先在近郊郊山走幾趟進行訓鞋磨合，能有效預防在長途縱走時磨出劇痛水泡。

examples.en: Never pop a fluid-filled blister on the trail because exposed raw skin invites serious bacterial infection.
examples.zh: 在野外健行途中千萬切忌隨意挑破充滿組織液的水泡，因為真皮裸露極易導致嚴重的細菌感染發炎。

words.definition: 雙向衛星通訊器 (Garmin inReach)

examples.en: Two-way satellite communicators transmit SOS coordinates without mobile cell coverage.
examples.zh: 雙向衛星通訊求救儀（如 inReach）在完全無手機基地台訊號的深山能發射 SOS 座標簡訊。

examples.en: The team used their satellite communicator to send brief check-in messages to anxious family members.
examples.zh: 登山團隊每晚在偏遠鞍部營地紮營後，透過衛星通訊發報機向山下牽掛的家屬發送平安報備簡訊。

examples.en: A satellite communicator provides an indispensable safety net during solo wilderness expeditions.
examples.zh: 在進行挑戰極限的深山獨攀冒險遠征時，一只雙向衛星通訊儀是不可或缺的最後保命安全底牌。

words.definition: 個人緊急定位發射器 (PLB)；燈塔

examples.en: Activating a Personal Locator Beacon (PLB) sends a distress signal directly to rescue centers.
examples.zh: 拔開安全插銷啟動個人定位信標（PLB），求救訊號將透過國際搜救衛星直接傳送至國家搜救中心。

examples.en: The lighthouse beacon shone its bright beam across the treacherous stormy ocean waves.
examples.zh: 屹立在海角崖壁上的燈塔發射出穿透濃霧的璀璨引航信標光芒，照亮狂風巨浪中的航行船隻。

examples.en: Unlike satellite messagers requiring annual subscriptions, a PLB links directly to military SAR satellites for free.
examples.zh: 與需要每年繳納月租費的商用衛星發報器不同，專用 PLB 信標能直接與全球軍用搜救衛星免費連線。

words.definition: 直升機鋼索吊掛；吊起提升

examples.en: The National Airborne Service Corps hoisted the injured hiker safely into the helicopter.
examples.zh: 內政部空中勤務總隊黑鷹直升機以精湛飛行技術頂風懸停，成功將受傷山友以鋼索安全吊掛上機。

examples.en: Construction cranes slowly hoist massive steel I-beams up to the forty-second floor.
examples.zh: 工地重型塔式起重吊車緩緩開動鋼索，將數十噸重的主體鋼骨工字鋼樑穩穩吊升至四十二層高樓。

examples.en: After securing the rescue harness, the airborne paramedic signaled the pilot to initiate the cable hoist.
examples.zh: 在確認將傷患妥善固定進搜救吊籃吊帶後，空勤搜救員向機長打出手勢信號，正式啟動鋼索起吊回收。

words.definition: 高山氣象學；氣象狀況

examples.en: Check specialized mountain meteorology forecasts for wind chill and storm probabilities.
examples.zh: 出發前請密切鎖定氣象署高山專屬氣象預報，掌握山頂體感溫度、風寒效應與降雨機率變化。

examples.en: Alpine meteorology explains why sunny valleys can suddenly give way to blinding ridge blizzards.
examples.zh: 高山氣象學精闢闡釋了為何明明山下谷地艷陽高照，山脊稜線上卻會突發伸手不見五指的強烈暴風雪。

examples.en: Studying meteorology helps expedition leaders recognize dangerous cloud signatures before squalls hit.
examples.zh: 研習基礎氣象學原理，能協助登山領隊在狂暴雷雨風暴來臨前，提前精準辨識出危險的積雨雲特徵。

words.definition: 高山午後強烈雷陣雨

examples.en: Summertime alpine hikers aim to reach shelters before hazardous 1 PM thunderstorms hit.
examples.zh: 夏季攀登百岳請務必養成摸黑早起出發的習慣，爭取在午後一點高山劇烈雷陣雨降臨前抵達山屋。

examples.en: Deafening lightning strikes during a mountain thunderstorm make exposed rocky summits deadly.
examples.zh: 在高山劇烈雷陣雨肆虐期間震耳欲聾的雷擊頻發，使毫無遮蔽的開闊岩石山頂成為極度致命的雷擊區。

examples.en: When an unexpected thunderstorm strikes an open ridge, descend immediately away from metal gear.
examples.zh: 當在開闊的無遮蔽山脊稜線突遭強烈雷雨襲擊時，應立即迅速下撤並將登山杖與金屬器械卸下放置遠處。

words.definition: 壯觀逆溫層雲海 (Cloud Inversion)

examples.en: Cold air trapped in the valley created a breathtaking sea of clouds inversion.
examples.zh: 谷底沉積的冷空氣形成大氣逆溫層，在山腰翻湧成一片波瀾壯闊、宛如仙境般的壯美雲海。

examples.en: Standing on the peak, we looked down at a vast fluffy cloud inversion stretching across the horizon.
examples.zh: 佇立在三千公尺頂峰極目遠眺，我們居高臨下俯瞰著一片綿延至天際盡頭的無垠棉花糖翻騰雲海。

examples.en: Meteorological inversions trap morning valley moisture, keeping high mountain peaks clear and dry.
examples.zh: 氣象逆溫層效應將濃重的水氣死死鎖在山谷盆地之中，反而讓高聳的山頂終日維持晴朗乾燥與純淨。

words.definition: 三百六十度全景壯麗大景

examples.en: The mountain top offers an uninterrupted 360-degree alpine panorama of Taiwan's central spine.
examples.zh: 佇立在三千九百公尺的高山三角點頂峰，全景三百六十度無遮蔽俯瞰台灣中央山脈脊樑的雄偉大景。

examples.en: From the observation tower, visitors marveled at the scenic panorama of the glittering harbor.
examples.zh: 登上高聳的高空觀景台，遊客們紛紛為眼前波光粼粼、千帆競發的海港壯闊全景發出陣陣讚嘆。

examples.en: She adjusted her camera's wide-angle lens to capture the sweeping mountain panorama at sunrise.
examples.zh: 她熟練調整單眼相機的超廣角鏡頭焦距，力求在破曉黎明時分完整捕捉山川連綿的壯麗全景大片。

words.definition: 高山金色日出；晨曦破曉

examples.en: Golden dawn sunlight broke through the horizon, setting the surrounding peaks ablaze.
examples.zh: 清晨第一道金燦燦的破曉曙光穿透東方雲海地平線，瞬間將周遭連綿起伏的百岳群峰染成一片璀璨金黃。

examples.en: Hikers woke up at 3:30 AM to hike the final mile to watch the sunrise above the clouds.
examples.zh: 熱血山友們在凌晨三點半從睡袋中翻身起床，摸黑完成最後一公里衝刺，只為在雲海之上迎候金色日出。

examples.en: The vibrant orange and purple tones of the sunrise reflected beautifully across the mountain tarn.
examples.zh: 破曉日出時分絢爛奪目的橘紅與紫粉色彩霞，倒映在高山靜謐的看天池冰斗湖面，美得令人窒息。

words.definition: 百岳最高頂峰；高峰會議；登頂

examples.en: After six grueling hours of uphill climbing, the mountaineering team summited Mt. Snow.
examples.zh: 歷經連續六個小時咬牙苦撐的高強度陡坡跋涉，登山隊全體隊員終於成功登頂雪山主峰。

examples.en: Frost coated the summit marker as the morning sun warmed the exhausted climbing expedition.
examples.zh: 當破曉晨曦漸漸溫暖疲憊不堪的登山隊伍時，高山三角點頂峰石碑上覆蓋著一層晶瑩剔透的白霜。

examples.en: World leaders gathered in Geneva for an emergency economic summit regarding global inflation.
examples.zh: 全球主要大國領袖齊聚瑞士日內瓦召開緊急經濟高峰會議，就抑制全球通膨危機展開磋商。

words.definition: 堅韌體能耐力；忍耐力

examples.en: Multi-day mountain traverses demand exceptional aerobic capacity and cardiovascular endurance.
examples.zh: 挑戰長達一週的中央山脈南二段或能高安東軍高山縱走，極度需要強大的心肺與肌耐力。

examples.en: Long-distance trail running builds extraordinary leg endurance and mental fortitude.
examples.zh: 長期堅持越野山徑跑訓練，能為人體建立起非凡卓越的腿部肌肉耐力與堅不可摧的鋼鐵心理意志。

examples.en: The heroic marathon runner pushed through severe exhaustion through sheer willpower and physical endurance.
examples.zh: 這位英雄般的馬拉松健兒憑藉純粹的鋼鐵意志與頑強體能耐力，在極度力竭狀態下咬牙衝過終點線。

words.definition: 患難與共的山友情誼；同袍之誼

examples.en: Shared hardships on rain-swept trails forge unbreakable lifetime bonds of mountain camaraderie.
examples.zh: 在狂風驟雨的泥濘山徑中彼此扶持、同甘共苦的深厚經歷，鍛造出終身難忘的山友革命情誼。

examples.en: Gathering around the camp stove to cook a communal dinner cultivates genuine camaraderie.
examples.zh: 深夜圍坐在高山露營爐具旁合力烹煮一鍋熱騰騰的共享羊肉爐，最能醞釀出發自肺腑的溫暖同袍情誼。

examples.en: True team camaraderie means looking out for the slowest hiker and pacing the group together.
examples.zh: 真正的團隊患難革命情誼，體現在主動放慢腳步體貼照看走在隊伍最後方的山友，始終同進同退。

words.definition: 謙遜謙卑之心；虛心

examples.en: Standing beneath towering ancient peaks instills deep reverence and quiet personal humility.
examples.zh: 佇立在巍峨雄偉的億萬年古老群山腳下，令人自發湧現出對大自然的敬畏與內心深處的謙卑。

examples.en: Approaching challenging high mountains with humility keeps climbers safe from reckless decisions.
examples.zh: 始終對巍峨險峻的高山懷抱敬畏與謙卑之心，能時刻提醒登山者杜絕狂妄自大並遠離魯莽冒險的抉擇。

examples.en: Despite his Nobel Prize achievements, the elderly scientist spoke with remarkable modesty and humility.
examples.zh: 儘管榮獲諾貝爾獎等無數至高殊榮，這位德高望重的老科學家在公眾面前發言時始終保有極致的謙遜。

words.definition: 敬畏尊崇；虔誠敬意

examples.en: Indigenous Bunun hunters treat sacred mountain forests with ancestral respect and reverence.
examples.zh: 世代守護山林的布農族高山嚮導以祖靈信仰為引導，對神聖山林草木始終懷抱最深沉的敬畏。

examples.en: Mountaineers bow their heads in silent reverence before the imposing face of the great mountain.
examples.zh: 攀登好手在巍峨聳立的巨大神山岩壁腳下肅穆佇立，深情低下頭顱致以最純粹虔誠的敬仰與尊崇。

examples.en: The ancient temple was preserved with immense reverence by generations of dedicated local monks.
examples.zh: 這座依山而建的千年古老寺院，在世代虔誠出家僧眾的悉心照拂下，被無比莊嚴虔誠地完整傳承保存至今。

words.definition: 凱旋登頂；勝利克服；大獲全勝

examples.en: Standing at the summit is not conquering the mountain, but a triumph over oneself.
examples.zh: 站在百岳頂峰的真正意義並非征服高山，而是戰勝內心恐懼、實現自我蛻變的極致精神勝利。

examples.en: The courageous mountaineering expedition was celebrated nationwide as a magnificent athletic triumph.
examples.zh: 這支英勇無畏的極地攀登遠征隊凱旋歸國時，受到了舉國上下如雷鳴般的熱烈歡呼與體育凱旋禮遇。

examples.en: Overcoming physical exhaustion to complete the rigorous Central Mountain Range traverse was a personal triumph.
examples.zh: 戰勝全身上下的極致體能透支力竭、圓滿完成嚴苛艱險的中央山脈大縱走，是一場刻骨銘心的個人勝利。
